p: of Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua
regarding the seventh day of Pesach it says,
and regarding Shemini Atzeres it is written,
"It shall be an assembly for you"
half for Hashem and half for yourselves.
Seemingly, what does one have to do with the other?
Perhaps on the seventh day of Pesach
One can answer according to the plain level
that we derive a gezeirah shavah
And in the inner meaning of the matter,
that regarding the seventh day of Pesach
it is written "an assembly to Hashem your God,"
while regarding Shemini Atzeres it is written "for you,"
it is along the lines of
what is brought in the holy Zohar
on the pasuk "This month shall be for you"
Aviv, in the order of the letters;
and I – from above to below:
which is the time of the Exodus from Egypt,
it is in the aspect of "with Me is the crushed one"
that is, that as it were
the Holy One, blessed be He, raised up
and lifted us to Himself, may He be blessed,
in the forty-nine gates of impurity,
and against them too was the claim,
"In what way are these different from those?"
a maidservant saw at the Sea
because Hashem, may He be blessed,
in the order of the letters.
for then they were absorbed into holiness
from the side of Hashem, may He be blessed,
until the Giving of the Torah;
the festival of Shavuos is called Atzeres
in the language of the Sages.
However, after the Giving of the Torah,
to arouse themselves from their own side
until they would merit the second Luchos;
and this is the aspect of
that, as it were, Hashem, may He be blessed,
contracts the holiness of His Shechinah, may He be blessed,
is in the month of Tishrei,
as is brought in the Tikkunim
"'And there was light' – this is Rosh Hashanah."
And on Yom Kippur we merit
that everything be atoned and repaired,
for it is the time of receiving
And on the festival, too, we draw down
the surrounding light together with the inner light
to the day of Shemini Atzeres,
the absorption of holiness from our side is completed;
and on this it is written,
it shall be an assembly for you" – precisely "for you."
כִּי זֶה עִיקַּר טַעַם רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר
For this is the essential reason of Rabbi Eliezer,
that is, if one senses within himself
that he can draw down holiness
and if he is not on that level,
that through the holiness of the festival
into the half that is "for yourselves."
"an assembly to Hashem your God" comes
precisely on the seventh day of Pesach,
specifically from the aspect of "Hashem your God,"
and not from the side of man.
it says "it shall be for you,"
so that our strength is sufficient
to make out of all the matters of "for yourselves,"
a drawing down of the indwelling of holiness into them.
And this is as we heard
in the name of the holy Rebbe of Peshischa,
זֵכֶר צַדִּיק וְקָדוֹשׁ לִבְרָכָה לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא,
may the memory of the righteous and holy be a blessing for the life of the World to Come,
that Shemini Atzeres is the Ushpiza
of Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him;
and this hints to our earlier words
that the culmination of the clarification and rectification
what we accomplished through teshuvah and prayer,
and it becomes clear that all our deeds,
And this too is the aspect of
Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
through whom was clarified the entire endeavor
of David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
by the power of his teshuvah and his prayer,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
that Hashem, may He be blessed, said to him,
"In your lifetime I will not make it known;
in the lifetime of Shlomo your son
I will make it known," et cetera;
when the gates clung together, et cetera,
except by one who is clean
of the venom of the Serpent,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
he would have lived and endured;
behold Eliyahu, who did not sin,
until one reaches completeness of life,
And therefore David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
to come to this level in his lifetime;
only in the days of Shlomo his son
was the culmination of the clarification completed for him;
meaning that there was completed in him the aspect of
"David, King of Yisrael, lives and endures"
just as the culmination of the clarification in this will be
in the days of Mashiach ben David
with Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
as it says immediately after this,
"And he made a feast for all his servants"
and also "And Shlomo's provision was, etc."
and also that entire generation was
and also according to the plain sense,
because it was in their power
into all the matters of the pleasures
like the matter of Rabbeinu HaKadosh,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said
that there never ceased from his table, et cetera,
and he said, "I did not derive enjoyment
was of the aspect of one who did not sin,
like Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
as we have spoken of this.
But with Shlomo HaMelech, peace be upon him,
there would already have been completed
the culmination of the clarification in this world
as in the days of Mashiach,
when there will be the repair of the blemish.
אֲבָל עַל יְדֵי שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה זַכָּאִים,
But because they were not worthy,
the sin was then hung upon Shlomo
to include Shlomo too among them
until a heavenly voice came forth:
"Shall He recompense it according to your mind,
that you have rejected it, etc.?"
That is, in this matter there is no
dealing according to the grasp of the intellect
only before Him, may He be blessed, is it revealed and known
only from the eyes of man
